sources.kind: deposited result file (first ~3 MB of gzip stream)

claims.evidence: Methods: knockouts bred against C57BL/6JBomTac background for >=10 generations; WT C57BL/6JBomTac littermates and commercial mice (Taconic).
KO/CTR (plasma) and KO/WT (platelet) tokens in deposited RAW names; paper compares Epac1-/- vs WT.
Methods: 'Epac1-/- and Epac2-/- mice are healthy and apparently indistinguishable from WT mice under standard housing.'
Neither stated for blood-donor mice; unavailable evidence.
RAW header strings 'Orbitrap Velos Pro'; Methods 'LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro'. PRIDE field 'LTQ Orbitrap' overridden as too generic.

claims.value: DDA PRIDE:0000627; CID MS:1000133; 35% NCE; radial ejection linear ion trap MS:1000083; 300m/z-2000m/z
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: DDA, survey 300-2000 m/z in Orbitrap, top-7 low-energy CID in linear ion trap, normalized collision energy 35%; RAW method name TOP7_..._CE35.

claims.value: one row per plasma RAW; source = genotype + mouse number + preparation
claims.evidence: Deposited names <mouse>_<KO|CTR>_<Crude|Depl>.raw; header acquisition paths C:\Xcalibur\Data\FrodeS\20120621_EPAC_FSEO\<same name>; S1 sample columns KO1, KO2and7, KO3-KO6, CTR8, CTR9, CTR10, CTR12, CTR13.

claims.value: mouse number (1-7 KO; 8,9,10,12,13 WT); 12a_CTR_Crude.raw = separate source WT_mouse12a_plasma_crude, biological replicate 14
claims.evidence: Number prefix of RAW names. 12a is not tied to mouse 12 by any ID (RAW header has only the file name; S1 has a single CTR12 column). It is coded as a separate animal, inferred from the paper's Figure 4 legend (WT n = 6), which needs six WT animals from five WT IDs. Replicate 14 is an arbitrary distinct integer.

Plasma 'crude or depleted for Albumin' (PRIDE description); Qproteome Murine Albumin Depletion Kit (Methods); Crude/Depl tokens in names; PRIDE XML titles 'plasma crude' (29639) and 'plasma-depleted' (29638).

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Methods 'precursor mass tolerance of 10 ppm, fragment mass tolerance of 0.7'; PRIDE XML 'Peptide mass tolerance setting 10.0', 'Fragment mass tolerance setting 0.7'. Da unit inferred (OMSSA, ion-trap MS2).

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C Fixed (UNIMOD:4); Oxidation M Variable (UNIMOD:35)
claims.evidence: 'fixed carbamidomethylation on cystein, variable oxidation on methionine'. No native search parameter file deposited.
S5 'Trypsination of protein samples in solution': DTT reduction, iodoacetamide alkylation; assigned to plasma (the in-solution digest) by inference.

limitations: Mouse 12a: whether 12a_CTR_Crude.raw comes from a separate animal from mouse 12 (12_CTR_Depl.raw) is not stated; coded as a separate source (biological replicate 14), inferred from WT n = 6 in the Figure 4 legend.

Figure 4 legend gives WT n = 6 / KO n = 7, while Table S1 has 5 WT and 6 KO columns (CTR12 and KO2and7 each apparently cover two animals). 'Mouse1-6: Epac1 KO' / 'Mouse7-11: WT' in the S2 ANOVA sheets are column positions, not animal IDs.
Mouse 7 (KO) has only a depleted run; S1 shows a merged 'KO2and7' quantification column.
Sex and developmental stage of donor mice not stated.
Modifications taken from Methods prose; PRIDE-generated mzTab lists MOD:01090/MOD:01047, judged a mass-mapping artefact.
Independent adversarial review not yet performed.
